Interpretation: MMR/MSI and actionable driver alterations remain established treatment-selection variables; spatial niches do not replace them.
Niche–target concordance does not establish that the target creates the niche or that drugging the target will eliminate it.
No response rate, survival benefit or synergy was inferred from spatial expression alone.
Failed or weak clinical approaches were kept to prevent mechanistic plausibility from being mistaken for class-level efficacy.
Spatial coverage identifies non-redundant intervention modules for trial design; it is not a recommendation to administer all modules simultaneously.
